levels.surface: عبد الله بن مسلمة بن قعنب

notes: «- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«قال قرأت على مالك» : Yahya read to Malik, so Malik is a link in his branch (rule 5)
Two branches join by «ح»; the names written once after the last «ح» (Ja'far, his father, Jabir) form the shared tail
